2014. Vehicle Polymorphism Using Interface

90

Hard

Problem Statement

Create an interface Vehicle with two methods:

getSpeed()
display()

Create three classes:

Car
Bike
Bus

Each class should implement both methods.

Use a Vehicle reference to demonstrate runtime polymorphism and display the speed of the selected vehicle.
input_spec:
The first line contains the vehicle type: car, bike, or bus.

The second line contains its speed.
output_spec: Print the vehicle type and speed.
